# scripts/differential-baseline.txt
#
# Known VM <-> CPython divergences. Generated by:
#     scripts/vm-differential.sh --update
# Each line is a unit id (a .ty path, or a project dir ending in '/')
# whose `tyc run` output does NOT match `tyc build` + python3.13.
#
# The VM is contractually a drop-in for the compiled path, so EVERY
# line here is a bug. This file exists only so the gate can fail on
# NEW divergences while the known set is burned down. Fixing a VM bug
# means deleting lines from this file — the gate also fails when a
# listed unit stops diverging, so the list cannot rot.
#
# Triage a single entry with:
#     scripts/vm-differential.sh --filter '<unit>' --keep
# then diff cpy.out / vm.out (and read vm.err) in the kept workdir.
#
# ENVIRONMENT-SENSITIVE: each unit's classification (ok / diverge /
# vacuous) depends on which third-party packages the ambient
# python3.13 can import — e.g. every `model` class needs pydantic at
# runtime, and one stress unit imports yaml. Record (--update) and
# verify this baseline with the same package set importable:
#     pydantic, PyYAML
# (CI installs pinned versions in the differential job — see
# .github/workflows/ci.yml.) On a machine missing them, affected
# baseline entries are reported as 'unverifiable here' and skipped
# rather than failed; affected non-baseline units may show up as new
# divergences the recording environment would not produce.
#
# Generated 2026-09-02 against tyc 1.0.0-alpha.9
# Scope: all
#
